user.title: Connect to the Enet Smart Home server
user.description: Enter the address and the login of your Enet Smart Home server.

data_description.url: Address of the Enet Smart Home server, for example http://192.168.1.10. Use https:// if the server is set up for it.
data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.
